hypotheses.rationale: Day 6 shows no early morning workspace activity (unlike Day 5), suggesting a slight shift to a more relaxed weekend start, but late evening activity persists. The lack of second-person indicators remains strong.
Still unlikely due to Day 5/6 daytime activity, but the absence of early morning work on Day 6 (Sunday) might hint at a non-standard schedule if Day 7 (Monday) also lacks early activity.
No new evidence of a second person. The 'elsewhere' locations for objects on Day 6 do not imply a second resident.
